title: Cancellation and Expiry of Referrals and Authorizations
content:
An approved authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** ends by cancellation, by expiry or by exhaustion of its units. This chapter governs cancellation and expiry.

## Cancellation

A patient may cancel an approved authorization they no longer need, only by their own confirmation: the agent records the request as an intake, and the patient (or the parent or guardian of a minor patient) confirms it. The authorization is then cancelled.

## Expiry

An authorization expires on the day after the last day of its validity span. An approved authorization whose span has ended with units still unused becomes expired.

## Release of units

Units are released only from an authorization whose status is cancelled or expired, as read from its status in the system record. A release is recorded as a release entry giving the reason, cancellation or expiration.

> Earlier release clause: cancellation and expiry release every unit still remaining, where the type's cancellation or expiry setting releases units.

That earlier release clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## No reopening

A cancelled or expired authorization is never reopened; later care needs a new request.

## Status table

| Status | Units may be released | May be reopened |
|---|---|---|
| approved | no | not applicable |
| cancelled | yes | no |
| expired | yes | no |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Specialty Care Referral's span ends on 28 August. On 29 August, the day after the last span day, it expires; from then on any further specialty visit needs a new request.

superseded_clauses: Cancellation and expiry release every unit still remaining where cancellation_releases_units or expiry_releases_units is true.
